stateContract.mustard: selected motion or warning / approaching a limit; form and motion distinguish the two uses
stateContract.teal: successful protective trip, paired with visible travel or a latched form
stateContract.coral: failure, breakage or consequence; a device that fails to actuate remains in its rest geometry with a stall or slash cue
stateContract.constraint: one semantic colour per frame except an explicit six-frame state handoff
